scope: Extend the existing implementation workflow with one immutable bounded task descriptor; fix notification busy-control recovery after concurrent read mutation; preserve old contracts and source history.
riskAnalysis: Server-owned immutable task definitions must not become model-controlled file/command authority. Current-source admission and explicit historical copy replay stay separate. Product fix redraws current state only; generation fences remain unchanged.

threatModel.assets: Source/task identity, frozen receipt integrity, current dashboard read state, permissions and publication boundaries.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Server-authenticated descriptor and immutable source asset vs untrusted model patch; disposable data copy vs actual repository; Work publication vs internal agents.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged descriptor, arbitrary regex/path/test profile, stale source substituted for current, source execution escalation, altered review, real account mutations hidden in QA.
threatModel.mitigations: Whole-asset hash/exact descriptor equality, one-edit closed grammar,512bytes, exact preimage/binding/evidence, source-only admission, current resolved-task denial, fixed VM source-hash rejection, no new paid policy, fully intercepted synthetic browser mutations.

defects.rootCause: Pending notification refresh finally cleared loading but skipped rendering after a successful read mutation changed the generation fence.
defects.detectionGap: Existing stale-data tests checked state but not last rendered loading controls.
defects.regression: Seven success/error/malformed read-race/failure/duplicate cases and real rendered client/admin intercepted read race.
defects.historicalPrevention: Keep request fences for data/error writes; always redraw current state after loading release. Preserve original failure artifact.

defects.rootCause: Implementation metadata, schema and patch validation were hardwired to a single completed Starter task.
defects.detectionGap: Five-stage source-copy fixture previously exercised one source task only.
defects.regression: Second immutable descriptor through all five real controller stages with offline reasoning, adversarial binding/path/descriptor/grammar checks, old compact/prose request identity and null execution-profile rejection.
defects.historicalPrevention: Register reviewed immutable task data; never accept caller task definitions or default historical source for live admission.

defects.rootCause: New-task metadata/schema initially inherited2048bytes while descriptor enforced512.
defects.detectionGap: Schema and backend limits were not initially compared.
defects.regression: Explicit schema/request/backend512 agreement; preserve old noarg schema unchanged.
defects.historicalPrevention: Independent Auditor identified mismatch before release; keep descriptor-derived limits in each new task branch.

rollback: Revert only this feature Preview batch on verification failure; preserve all source/history/diagnostic evidence and revoked grants. No main or Production mutation.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing five-stage workflow and patch validator with immutable task data, not new orchestration.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No new packages, credential changes, provider requests or infrastructure.
proactiveReview.threats: Forged descriptor, arbitrary regex/path/test profile, stale source substituted for current, source execution escalation, altered review, real account mutations hidden in QA.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Resolved/current drift denies new tasks; history remains readable. Fixture success does not prove live reasoning or dynamic execution.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Descriptor/path/source/workspace/grammar/protected command substitutions, no test-profile inheritance, concurrent read refresh failure paths.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Root reviews QA-authored browser/test fixtures; independent Work QA/Auditor review root task/product implementation. Final hosted review required.
proactiveReview.recovery: Retain original source snapshots, all old receipts/rejections and v1-v5 evidence. Work-only source publication, no grant revival.
proactiveReview.readiness: Current-source five-stage fixture completed with offline reasoning;27contract/bounded and64integration plus13product checks passed. Remote STRICT/Redis/security/Browser/archive qualification pending.
